chunks: Muhammad b. 'Ali narrated to us. He said: 'Ali b. Muhammad b. Abi'l Qasim narrated to us from his father from Muhammad b. Abi 'Umar al-'Adani in Mecca from Abu'l 'Abbas b. Hamza from Ahmad b. Sawwar from 'Ubaydallah b. 'Asim from Salama b. Wardan from Anas b. Malik. He said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family) said:

If a believer dies leaving behind one sheet of knowledge, that sheet will be a curtain between him and the Fire on the Day of Resurrection. For every letter written on it, Allah, blessed and exalted, will grant him a city seven times wider than this world. And no believer sits a moment with a scholar except that his Lord, mighty and exalted, calls to him: 'You have sat to attend My beloved. By My glory and My majesty, I will surely make you dwell in Paradise with him, regardless.'

key_terms.الْعَالِم: The scholar — one who possesses and transmits sacred knowledge
key_terms.حَبِيبِي: My beloved — God's term of endearment for the scholar
key_terms.سِتْرًا: A curtain/veil — used here as a protective barrier between the believer and the Fire

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for seeking and preserving knowledge according to the Prophet Muhammad?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) teaches that a believer who dies leaving even a single sheet of written knowledge will find it as a barrier between himself and the Hellfire on the Day of Judgment. Moreover, for every letter written on it, God will grant him a city seven times wider than the world. And any believer who sits with a scholar will be addressed by God, who declares that the scholar is His beloved and swears to settle the seeker in Paradise.
word_analysis: I will surely make you dwell
